THIS CASE came before the Court of Workers’
Compensation Claims for approval of the attached
Settlement Agreement.  The Court considered the
Agreement, the Parties’ statements, and Counsels’
representations.
After determining that the Employee understands
Employee’s rights provided by the Workers’
Compensation Law and the potential benefits to
which the Employee may be entitled, the Court finds
that settlement of this disputed claim, under Tenn.
Code Ann. § 50-6-240(e), is in Employee’s best
interests.
Employee’s attorney is entitled to a fee of up to
20% of the recovery or award plus incurred expenses.
Employee’s attorney is taking a fee of 20% or
$4,500.00.  The undersigned Workers’ Compensation
Specialist has reviewed the fees of Counsel for the
Employer and deems that same are reasonable
pursuant to Tenn. Code Ann. § 50-6-226.
THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IS
HEREBY APPROVED .  The attached written
Agreement and all its terms are incorporated in their
entirety into this Order.
IT IS SO ORDERED.
